title: SmartAssist AI Platform Outage
description: The SmartAssist AI Platform is completely unavailable. Users cannot log in or access any AI-assisted features. Root cause identified as a failed database migration deployed at 08:15 IST.

title: VPN Intermittent Connectivity Issues
description: The company VPN is experiencing intermittent connectivity drops affecting remote workers. Users report frequent disconnections every 15-20 minutes. Network team is investigating routing configuration.

title: Employee Portal Login Failures - Hyderabad Office
description: Multiple employees in the Hyderabad office are unable to log in to the Employee Portal. The issue appears related to the SSO (Single Sign-On) authentication service.

title: Internal Developer Portal Slow Response
description: The Internal Developer Portal is experiencing significant slowness. Pages take 30-60 seconds to load. Performance team suspects a memory leak in the application server.

title: HR Management System - Report Generation Failure
description: The HR Management System is unable to generate monthly reports. The scheduled job fails with a timeout error. All other HRMS functions are working normally.

title: Finance Network Segment - Packet Loss
description: The Finance department network segment in the Chennai office is showing 15% packet loss. This is causing intermittent failures in financial transaction processing.
